summary: Add services/rankings/store.py as the independent, persistent write owner for Rankings records: a durable JSON-file backend (mtime-gated reload + flock + atomic temp-file/fsync/rename writes) for dev, and a PostgresJsonOwnerStore-backed owner table for staging/prod, selected by build_rankings_store(). No import of services/control-plane/bff/read_store.py and no local dict/overlay/cache/response fallback: every read re-reads the durable backing store so a write is visible to a separate store instance immediately (write-then-fresh-read). services/control-plane/bff/main.py and read_store.py are unmodified; Source Ingestion gets no new write entrypoint and remains reconcile-only against this domain.
